a meeting.

Thanks for coming to this product development meeting.
As you know, we've recently reduced the amount of
packaging we use for our Tucker Treats snack bags, in
order to be more eco-friendly. But ®customers aren’t happy
because our new packaging now offers smaller quantities
of Tucker Treats at their original prices, which means they're
paying more for less food. Our president, Young-Soo Lee,
has approved changing the size of the packaging to offer
larger quantities of snacks at the original prices. So, ®your
next task is to come up with a new package design to hold
the larger quantities, while still using less plastic.
context.transcript_translation:
一次会议。
谢谢您参加这次产品开发会议。如您所知，为了更环保，我们最近减少了用于我们的“Tuck Treats”零食袋的包装量。但顾客不高兴，因为我们新的包装在原价下提供的“Tuck Treats”数量变少了，这意味着他们为更少的食物支付了更多的钱。我们的总裁李永秀批准更改包装尺寸，以便以原价提供更大数量的零食。所以，你们接下来的任务是想出一个新的包装设计，来装载更大的数量，同时仍然使用更少的塑料。
